function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a source-grounded investigation using only evidence and source IDs returned by the benchmark tools. Research the overall question: how can one determine whether and how the Ronin Bridge theft and the Harmony Horizon theft are publicly linked to one another and to Lazarus Group or APT38? Build a comprehensive evidence dossier for a final Markdown report followed by JSON. Systematically cover: (1) public attribution statements and assessments, distinguishing confirmed facts, allegations, analytical judgments, and uncertainty; (2) similarities and differences in laundering methods, transaction flows, intermediaries, bridges, mixers, exchanges, sanctions, and other behavioral indicators; (3) wallet addresses, named entities, relationships, transaction evidence, and other blockchain indicators associated with either theft or Lazarus Group/APT38; (4) strength, provenance, and limitations of each evidentiary link; and (5) contradictions and competing explanations. Treat unspecified time range, jurisdiction, source-type priority, attribution standard, and definition of “link” as open-ended. Do not invent facts, source IDs, wallet relationships, or entity names; do not rely on unstated assumptions. Cite exclusively the exact source IDs supplied by benchmark tools, and preserve them verbatim. If evidence is absent, say so. Organize the returned material by finding/question, answer, supporting entities, source references, claims, reasoning steps with premise entities and premise relations, and contradictions. Ensure every conclusion is calibrated to the evidence and explicitly notes uncertainty and source limitations."}
function.name: ConductResearch
